newsitem.title: ESTONIA: HOIUPANK DROPS LONG-TERM HOUSING LOAN RATES.
newsitem.headline: HOIUPANK DROPS LONG-TERM HOUSING LOAN RATES.

text.p: Hoiupank, Estonia's third largest bank, said on Tuesday that it will lower the interest rate on its long-term housing loans.
In a statement the bank said that from May 29 it will lower the rate for 10 year housing loans by 0.5 percent and for 10-15 year loans by one percent.
The new base rate for both loans is the six month German mark Libor plus seven percent.
Hoiupank has offered long-term housing loans since 1996 and currently the bank has 1600 clients with a 406 million kroon long-term housing loan portfolio.
